value.rationale: The paper's central design motivation is linear decay of the future influence of momentum, but it presents the time-varying replacement only as an approximation. Showing that the actual finite-horizon tail is exactly linear, with a uniform and explicit normalization error, validates and quantitatively calibrates the design principle rather than merely recomputing a schedule value. The one-step-shifted gradient formula also resolves the finite-horizon indexing precisely.
